"Our negotiations are with Oman, we are focused on reaching an understanding on a route that will ensure safe shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. "As long as America's evil continues, as long as the naval blockade of Iran is declared, as long as America's military aggression against Iran and its interests continues, and as long as all the things that America has violated during this period continue, there will be no significant change in the situation in the Strait of Hormuz. Therefore, the focus of the negotiations with Oman will be on this issue, and the issues related to Iran and the United States should be examined in the next stages to see in which direction the situation will go..."
